units.i2v_prompt: Medium shot from behind their shoulders. The young couple rides on through the tall golden grass, the boy leaning into the chrome handlebar and the girl sitting up behind him with one arm around his waist, the wheels turning at an even pace. A low cumulus bank drifts slowly along the left half of the sky, its ragged wind-eroded edge thinning into haze above the grass line. The camera tracks alongside at their pace, easing with each pedal stroke and settling. Preserve the film grain and the original color palette.
